_comment: Illustrations de l'app iOS, direction affiche (même réglages que manifest-poster.json), en deux couleurs : marine et safran sur papier crème. progress_poster = carte d'entrée « Ma progression » (profil), progress_hero = en-tête de la page « Ma progression », ambassador_poster = bannière « Deviens ambassadeur » des réglages. Sorties converties en JPEG dans ios/Sophia/Assets.xcassets/<nom>.imageset (carré 480 px pour progress_poster, 1200 × 900 pour les deux autres). Le fond n'est pas garanti par le modèle (il sort souvent bleu, vert ou corail) : relancer jusqu'à obtenir le fond crème ; pour progress_hero, la palette répète le crème en tête pour l'y pousser, et l'image est recadrée en 3:2.

items.name: progress_poster
items.prompt: A small simple navy figure climbing a staircase made of five big stacked books, a large saffron star with a laurel wreath shining above the top step. Two-color linocut print, paper-cut shapes: only deep navy blue ink and saffron yellow ink on plain cream off-white paper, the cream paper background fills most of the image, bold simple flat forms, subtle paper grain, generous empty cream space, no red, no light blue, no teal, no text, no letters, no outlines.

items.name: progress_hero
items.prompt: Cream off-white paper background. A small simple navy figure climbing a staircase made of big stacked navy and saffron books that rises from the lower left to the right, a large saffron star framed by two saffron laurel branches above the top step, a few tiny saffron sparkles. Two-color linocut print, paper-cut shapes: only deep navy blue ink and saffron yellow ink on plain cream off-white paper, the cream paper background fills most of the image, bold simple flat forms, subtle paper grain, generous empty cream space, no red, no light blue, no teal, no text, no letters, no outlines.

items.name: ambassador_poster
items.prompt: A cheerful simple navy figure holding up a big saffron megaphone, from which saffron stars, navy hearts and small open books fly out to the right; a little pennant flag planted beside the figure. Two-color linocut print, paper-cut shapes: only deep navy blue ink and saffron yellow ink on plain cream off-white paper, the cream paper background fills most of the image, bold simple flat forms, subtle paper grain, generous empty cream space, no red, no light blue, no teal, no text, no letters, no outlines.

items.name: antiscroll_poster
items.prompt: Plain cream off-white paper background. A navy blue smartphone standing upright with a saffron yellow padlock on its dark screen, in front of it a big open book with saffron cover, a few tiny saffron sparkles. Two-color linocut print, paper-cut shapes: only deep navy blue ink and saffron yellow ink printed on plain cream off-white paper, the plain cream paper background fills most of the image, bold simple flat forms, subtle paper grain, generous empty cream space, no red, no pink, no green, no light blue, no teal, no text, no letters, no outlines.
items.note: Carte d'entrée de l'anti-scroll (profil), carré 480 px. Onze tirages, aucun sur fond crème : le fond rouge du tirage retenu a été remplacé par le crème (251, 247, 239) après coup.
